name: ShowMySites

sources.title: ShowMySites homepage — directory + launch platform, DR71+ backlink pitch
ShowMySites pricing — Free (reciprocal link/badge) vs $10 Premium

conditions: Free listings stay nofollow until a reciprocal link to ShowMySites or their badge is detected on your site
An account (signup) is required to add websites
requirements: Any website/project type accepted: SaaS, blogs, marketplaces, AI tools, apps
Up to 25 active listings per account on both Free and Premium
A page on your site where you can place a link or badge (free path)
preparation: Site name, URL, description, category and language for each listing
Reciprocal link or badge HTML ready to deploy
workflow: Add the website via /my-websites/create/ ('Join & Add Your Website')
Place a link to ShowMySites or embed their badge on your site
Their verification detects the link/badge and flips your outbound link to dofollow
Listing appears in the /directory/ and on the launch platform
watchFor: Without the reciprocal link/badge the outbound link is nofollow — the 'free dofollow' is explicitly a link exchange
Premium is $10 one-time per ACCOUNT (not per site) and removes the link/badge requirement for all 25 listings
Directory contains low-signal listings (gambling/spam-adjacent entries observed), which dilutes link quality
countsAsLive: The site has a public detail page in showmysites.com/directory/ and appears in 'Recently Launched'; the outbound link flips to dofollow once the badge/link is verified.
unknowns: How often the reciprocal-link check re-runs (and whether delisting follows removal)
Any manual review step before publication
Whether the 25-listing cap can be raised
